items.title: Hugging Face exploring sale valuing it at $13 billion, Business Insider says
items.summary: AI startup Hugging Face has been exploring a sale that could ‌value the company at $13 billion or ‌more, Business Insider reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with ​the matter.  The New York-based company, which hosts open-source large language models and datasets, has been working with a bank to gauge bidders' interest, the ‌report said.  • Hugging Face did not immediately respond to a Reuters ⁠request for comment outside regular business hours.
